page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6149 processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 12 physical cores and 12 vCPUs with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is categorized as weak, as demonstrated by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core metrics. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, supported by a Passmark CPU score of 11929.55 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 50.24 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth remains average, with cached read speeds reaching 603.79 GB/sec and uncached large block reads at 56.31 GB/sec, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the lower tier.

This hardware profile is suited for workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and multi-threaded processing without requiring local SSD storage or GPU acceleration. It handles static web serving at an average rate of 6.37 GB/sec and supports Redis SET operations up to 10.75 million operations per second. While small-model LLM inference runs at average speeds, medium-model inference performance is weak. The instance represents a balanced general-purpose option where dedicated compute resources are required, but single-threaded speed is not the primary bottleneck.
